sentences.en: Everything is a triangle in computer graphics.

sentences.en: Everything's just a bunch of triangles.

sentences.en: The three points of the triangle are called vertices.
sentences.zh: 三角形的三个点被称为顶点。

sentences.en: And so you have sort of an army of these vertices, just these triplets of vertices.
sentences.zh: 所以你有一群这样的顶点，就是这些顶点的三元组。

sentences.en: Like vertex A, B, and C make a triangle.
sentences.zh: 比如顶点 A、B 和 C 构成一个三角形。

sentences.en: D, E, and F make a triangle.
sentences.zh: D、E 和 F 构成一个三角形。

sentences.en: And they all flow through the system and get transformed.
sentences.zh: 它们都流经系统并被转换。

sentences.en: Like one possible transformation is, you know, if you're playing like a first-person shooter and you turn your head 90 degrees.
sentences.zh: 比如一种可能的转换是，如果你在玩第一人称射击游戏，然后把头转了 90 度。

sentences.en: Well, the way the graphics processing unit handles that is it rotates the whole world in the other direction 90 degrees.
sentences.zh: 那么 GPU 处理它的方式就是把整个世界向相反方向旋转 90 度。

sentences.en: And so every vertex gets rotated in space to like counteract your rotation and make you feel like you're turning, right?
sentences.zh: 所以每个顶点都在空间中旋转，以抵消你的旋转，让你感觉自己在转动，对吧？

sentences.en: Right, that's right.

sentences.en: So the vertex can be represented as a vector of three elements, you know, an X, Y, and Z component of the vertex.
sentences.zh: 所以顶点可以表示为一个包含三个元素的向量，也就是顶点的 X、Y 和 Z 分量。

sentences.en: And then, right, any operation that transforms a vertex is a matrix operation.
sentences.zh: 没错，任何转换顶点的操作都是矩阵运算。

sentences.en: So like rotation, scaling, transformation, and these kind of things.

sentences.en: So there's a vertex shader.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是顶点着色器。

sentences.en: Once all the vertices have been transformed, then they get crushed into the screen.
sentences.zh: 一旦所有顶点都被转换，它们就会被压入屏幕。

sentences.en: So you can imagine sort of like all the vertices in your screen, but they're all in 3D.

sentences.en: So they're all kind of these projections.

sentences.en: Then they get crushed into 2D.
sentences.zh: 然后它们被压成 2D。

sentences.en: And then what happens is something called a fragment shader starts at, looks at your three vertices and looks at every pixel that is within that triangle.
sentences.zh: 接着发生的事情是，所谓的片段着色器开始工作，它查看你的三个顶点，并查看该三角形内的每一个像素。

sentences.en: And then based on a bunch of different things, figures out the color of that pixel.
sentences.zh: 然后根据各种不同的因素，计算出该像素的颜色。

sentences.en: So for example, a triangle might be red, but there's a blue light shining on it.
sentences.zh: 例如，一个三角形可能是红色的，但有一束蓝光照在上面。

sentences.en: And it's facing that blue light.
sentences.zh: 而且它正对着那束蓝光。

sentences.en: So the fragment shader will sort of use all this data to sort of figure out like for this particular point in space, like what the color should be.
sentences.zh: 所以片段着色器会利用所有这些数据来计算出空间中这个特定点的颜色应该是多少。

sentences.en: So is that also the part responsible for determining like, oh, it's on the shadow side of the light or facing the light?

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: One interesting thing is for data on the GPU, there's three different types of arrays that you can allocate on the GPU.

sentences.en: Or read-write.

sentences.zh: 你可以选择一定的振幅，也就是余弦波的高度，以及一定的频率，也就是那些起伏的紧密程度。

sentences.en: And so, you can find, you know, a frequency and amplitude such that it tries to approximate, you know, like Kanye West's song or something like that, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，你可以找到一个频率和振幅，试图去近似，比如 Kanye West 的歌之类的，对吧？

sentences.en: And you won't get all of it, of course, with one cosine.
sentences.zh: 当然，你用一个余弦波是无法完全还原的。

sentences.en: You'll get a little bit of it.
sentences.zh: 你只能得到一部分。

sentences.en: So, then you take that part out of Kanye's song, and now it sounds a little different, but hopefully you find another cosine wave that can now match that new wave.
sentences.zh: 所以，你把那部分从 Kanye 的歌里减掉，现在听起来有点不同了，但希望你能找到另一个余弦波来匹配那个新的波形。

sentences.en: And then you basically keep doing this until you end up with nothing.
sentences.zh: 然后你基本上一直这样做，直到最后什么都不剩。

sentences.en: And you have, like, all these cosine waves, and when you add them together, you get Kanye West's song.
sentences.zh: 你就有了一堆余弦波，当你把它们加在一起时，你就得到了 Kanye West 的歌。

sentences.en: Yeah, so it essentially relies on the fact your ear can't hear all of the little differences.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以它本质上依赖于你的耳朵听不出所有细微差别的事实。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, if something's changing really, really fast, it's probably unimportant.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果有什么东西变化得非常非常快，那通常是不重要的。

sentences.en: It's probably just, quote-unquote, noise or whatever that can be filtered away.
sentences.zh: 那可能只是所谓的“噪声”之类的，可以被过滤掉。

sentences.en: Yeah, and so...
sentences.zh: 是的，所以……

sentences.en: And the same thing is true for images.
sentences.zh: 图像也是一样。

sentences.en: JPEG is the same thing.
sentences.zh: JPEG 也是同样的道理。

sentences.en: It tries to say, in this area of a white wall, there's almost no difference between two pixels.
sentences.zh: 它试图说，在白墙的这个区域，两个像素之间几乎没有区别。

sentences.en: So, if I just approximate it, you won't lose very much information.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我只是近似处理，你不会丢失太多信息。

sentences.en: It tries to very carefully pick what information to store, as opposed to storing everything.
sentences.zh: 它试图非常小心地选择要存储的信息，而不是存储所有东西。

sentences.en: Yep, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是这样。

sentences.en: And so, get back to NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 回到 NVIDIA 的话题。

sentences.en: So, NVIDIA has a Coup FFT library.
sentences.zh: NVIDIA 有一个 cuFFT 库。

sentences.en: You could totally use this to write your own GPU-based wave to MP3 transcoder.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以用它来编写你自己的基于 GPU 的波形转 MP3 转码器。

sentences.en: That would be super faSt.
sentences.zh: 那会非常快。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Then, okay, so there's also bindings for CUDA for many languages.
sentences.zh: 好的，CUDA 也有很多语言的绑定。

sentences.en: And it's pretty easy to write your own.
sentences.zh: 而且自己写一个也相当容易。

sentences.en: And then OpenCL, a standard, very close to OpenGL, in that, you know, it supports multiple CPUs and GPUs.
sentences.zh: 还有 OpenCL，这是一个标准，非常接近 OpenGL，因为它支持多种 CPU 和 GPU。

sentences.en: Interesting thing there, I said CPUs.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我提到了 CPU。

sentences.en: You can also, you know, your multi-core processor can be treated just like GPU.
sentences.zh: 你也可以，你知道，你的多核处理器可以像 GPU 一样被对待。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, you probably will lose out on doing something specific, but you could approximate something on a computer if someone doesn't have a GPU.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可能会在某些特定功能上有所损失，但如果某人没有 GPU，你可以在电脑上进行近似处理。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it makes it much easier to debug, too.
sentences.zh: 而且这让调试也容易得多。

sentences.en: You can actually debug on your CPU, catch any, you know, divide-by-zero errors and things like that, and then push it to the GPU once you're confident.
sentences.zh: 你实际上可以在 CPU 上调试，捕获任何除以零的错误之类的，一旦确定没问题，再推送到 GPU 上。

sentences.en: And you can support multiple brands of graphics cards.
sentences.zh: 而且你可以支持多个品牌的显卡。

sentences.en: Right, like if somebody, you know, imagine, like, you're releasing an app, you know, like some program you want people to download, a video game you're writing, or who knows,
sentences.zh: 没错，就像如果有人，想象一下，你要发布一个应用，比如你希望人们下载的程序，或者你正在写的视频游戏，谁知道呢，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: You know, you don't want to just give your game to people with NVIDIA graphics cards.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你不想只把游戏给有 NVIDIA 显卡的人。

sentences.en: You want everyone to have your game.
sentences.zh: 你希望每个人都能玩你的游戏。

sentences.en: And so, with OpenCL, it'll use, you know, NVIDIA, it'll use ATI, or I guess they're now AMD graphics cards.
sentences.zh: 所以有了 OpenCL，它可以使用 NVIDIA，可以使用 ATI，或者我想现在叫 AMD 显卡。

sentences.en: If it doesn't have any of those graphics cards, it can fall back to the CPU.
sentences.zh: 如果它没有这些显卡，它还可以回退到 CPU。

sentences.en: And so, it's much more versatile.
sentences.zh: 所以它更通用。

sentences.en: Yep, but similarly, my experience has been that they tend to implement things a little slower because it's a standard, so it takes a little longer to get everybody on board.
sentences.zh: 没错，但同样地，我的经验是，它们实现东西的速度往往慢一些，因为这是一个标准，所以让每个人都加入进来需要更长的时间。

sentences.en: And people tend to prefer their own implementation over the OpenCL, talking about manufacturers.
sentences.zh: 而且厂商往往更倾向于自己的实现，而不是 OpenCL。

sentences.en: So, you know, NVIDIA will support OpenCL at some level, but it's going to support CUDA better.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，NVIDIA 会在一定程度上支持 OpenCL，但它对 CUDA 的支持会更好。

sentences.en: And so, that also causes some probleMs.
sentences.zh: 所以，这也导致了一些问题。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Well, that's pretty much it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，基本上就是这样。

sentences.en: It was at a high level.
sentences.zh: 这是从宏观层面讲的。

sentences.en: We had a little bit of a venture off into Fourier land.
sentences.zh: 我们稍微跑题去了傅里叶的世界。

sentences.en: Yeah, we started with origami, and we ended with Fast Fourier Transform, so this is definitely an awesome show.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们从折纸开始，最后讲到了快速傅里叶变换，所以这绝对是一期精彩的节目。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, we've been getting emails still.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们还在收到邮件。

sentences.en: People were wondering where the show went.
sentences.zh: 人们想知道节目去哪儿了。

sentences.en: We've had busy lives having – Jason had a kid.
sentences.zh: 我们的生活很忙——Jason 有了孩子。

sentences.en: I had a kid.
sentences.zh: 我也生了孩子。

sentences.en: So, there are two more people in the world who will want to listen to the podcast one day.
sentences.zh: 所以世界上又多了两个人，以后会想听这个播客。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: Maybe or not.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，或者不一定。

sentences.en: Yeah, we both had children in the past, what, two months?
sentences.zh: 是的，我们俩都在过去，什么，两个月里生了孩子？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Three months?
sentences.zh: 三个月？

sentences.en: Four months?
sentences.zh: 四个月？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Okay, anyways.
sentences.zh: 好吧，总之。

sentences.en: It's all become kind of a blur.
sentences.zh: 一切都变得有些模糊了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We're definitely – we probably get eight hours of sleep between the two of us.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对——我们俩加起来可能也就睡八个小时。

sentences.en: On a good day.
sentences.zh: 在状态好的时候。

sentences.en: Yeah, on a good day.
sentences.zh: 是的，状态好的时候。

sentences.en: But, you know, our kids are getting, like – how old is yours, like four months now?
sentences.zh: 但，你知道，我们的孩子正在变大——你的多大了，四个月了？

sentences.en: Five months?
sentences.zh: 五个月？

sentences.en: Five months.
sentences.zh: 五个月。

sentences.en: Mine's almost four months.
sentences.zh: 我的快四个月了。

sentences.en: And so, now we're starting to get our lives back.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在我们开始找回自己的生活了。

sentences.en: A little.
sentences.zh: 一点点。

sentences.en: And as part of our lives include doing this show for you guys.
sentences.zh: 而我们的生活的一部分包括为你们做这个节目。

sentences.en: So, definitely thanks for all the love and support and the – hey, when are you guys doing an episode?
sentences.zh: 所以，非常感谢所有的爱与支持，还有那些——嘿，你们什么时候做新的一集？

sentences.en: That's really actually good that it sort of motivates us.
sentences.zh: 这其实真的很好，它激励了我们。

sentences.en: Yeah, keeps us honeSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，让我们保持诚实。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: So, we appreciate all the support.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们感谢所有的支持。

sentences.en: Thanks for looking at the books.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们关注那些书。

sentences.en: We have – you know, I haven't looked at the numbers lately, but there's a good amount of people buying the books we're recommending, which is great.
sentences.zh: 我们有——你知道，我最近没看数据，但有很多人在买我们推荐的书，这很棒。

sentences.en: Or at least clicking on the link and then buying something else, which also helps.
sentences.zh: 或者至少点击了链接然后买了别的东西，这也很有帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah, that works too.
sentences.zh: 是的，那样也行。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I mean, all of these books are ones that we've read.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我是说，所有这些书都是我们读过的。

sentences.en: They're not both of us, but the one who is recommending the book has read.
sentences.zh: 不是我们俩都读过，但推荐书的那个人读过。

sentences.en: And it's really good that you guys are getting into it too, so.
sentences.zh: 你们能参与进来真的很好，所以。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 下次见。
